text: {"bodies": ["Have you heard the whispers going around about Aleksi Lehtinen (e03) possibly being behind the document leaks? I obviously don't have anything to back it up, just repeating what people were saying near the coffee machine.", "Not to spread idle chatter, but a few folks are wondering if Laura Lehtinen (e06) might be the one sharing internal files outside the company. It is purely guesswork at this point, though it does make you wonder.", "Honestly, it wouldn't surprise me one bit if Aino Karjalainen (e00) is the person leaking things just to stir up drama. She always acts so smug in our meetings and loves making everyone else's life difficult.", "If we are looking for who is letting confidential info slip, I would look straight at Teemu Jokinen (e17). Anyone who leaves snide comments on every single shared draft clearly has zero respect for the rest of us."]}
